hotels.title: Lake Macquarie Beachfront Bliss just 90-Minutes from Sydney with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Treat yourself to the ultimate laidback escape at this beachfront gem, perfectly positioned just steps away from Caves Beach in New South Wales' Lake Macquarie region, only a 90-minute drive from Sydney. Set on the coastline overlooking the Pacific Ocean, Caves Coastal Bar & Bungalows boasts a romantic collection of townhouses and private villas and adults-only deluxe bungalows. With luxurious amenities and breathtaking views, these Hamptons-style stays are perfect for couples or groups and made for laidback coastal living. Go for sun-kissed walks on the beaches and trails, explore the caves at low tide, try your hand at watersports, enjoy a picnic or head into town to visit the cafes and boutiques. If you want to stay closer to home, visit the onsite restaurant for a complimentary drink paired with seasonal dishes and panoramic beach views. Enjoy freshly shucked oysters, wood-fired pizzas and more delicious bites showcasing the best local produce, or head to the expansive outdoor deck to soak up the fresh sea air in a relaxed environment.
